NCT01071044: Efficacy and Safety of Lisdexamfetamine Dimesylate in Adults With Chronic Fatigu

limitations: Very small n; 6-week duration; CFS criteria era may not match modern ME/CFS (CCC/IOM) with PEM emphasis; primary endpoint was BRIEF-A not PEM/function. Industry-relevant stimulant class harms. No replication Phase 3. Not medical advice. Tracker Moderate label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
